article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Manasseh Stackhouse had 19 points in IU Indianapolis’ 74-70 victory over Southern Indiana on Wednesday. Stackhouse added six rebounds and three blocks for the Jaguars (3-0). Billy Smith scored 11 points while going 3 of 7 (3 for 6 from 3-point range). Fredy-Salam Sylla led the way for the Screaming Eagles (1-3) with 16 points, 15 rebounds and two steals. Josh Smith and Afan Trnka each added 14 points. Up next IU Indianapolis plays Morehead State on the road Saturday, and Southern Indiana will host Western Michigan on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
